rules: When Architecture Designer has completed the architecture design and classifies the result as task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, and the cumulative architecture package is ready for independent architecture review.

When a Requirement Gap, Design Impact, or Unclear finding has been resolved in the updated architecture artifacts, the result remains task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, and the revised package is ready for another architecture review.

When Architecture Designer has completed the architecture design, classifies the result as task_size=Small or Medium and architectural_risk=Low, and the cumulative architecture package is ready for direct implementation without Architecture Reviewer. Include the classification, rationale, and route decision in the handoff.
When the architecture review passes and the cumulative reviewed architecture package is ready for implementation.

When the architecture review is Fail or Blocked with a Design Impact, Requirement Gap, or Unclear finding that requires architecture revision or upstream requirements clarification before implementation.
When architecture review passes and Architecture Designer needs the informational pass notification after the primary implementation handoff succeeds.

When implementation is complete and the carried classification is task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, implementation-scoped validation is complete, and the cumulative implementation package is ready for independent source review.

When an implementation-owned Local Fix requested by the code reviewer or delivery engineer is complete, the existing package is task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, and the updated implementation must return for source review.

When implementation is complete, implementation-scoped validation and the lightweight implementation self-review are complete, the carried classification is task_size=Small or Medium and architectural_risk=Low, and the cumulative package is ready for direct API/E2E validation without Code Reviewer.

When a direct-route implementation-owned Local Fix requested by delivery engineer is complete, the rechecked classification remains task_size=Small or Medium and architectural_risk=Low, and the updated package is ready for direct API/E2E validation.
When implementation identifies a Design Impact, Requirement Gap, or Unclear issue that must be resolved in the requirements or design before implementation continues.
When implementation review passes and the cumulative package is ready for API, end-to-end, and executable coverage work.
When a test-code, stale-test, fixture, environment, execution, or reporting Local Fix is complete and API/E2E must rerun the affected validation.
When API/E2E failure-origin review confirms that the owning problem is in coverage, test code, fixtures, environment, execution, or reporting.
When post-API/E2E test-code review fails and an API/E2E-owned correction is required.
When source review identifies an implementation-owned Local Fix or packaging defect that must be corrected before executable coverage.
When API/E2E failure-origin review confirms that the owning problem is an implementation defect.
When implementation review passes and Implementation Engineer needs the informational pass notification after the primary API/E2E handoff succeeds.
When review identifies a Design Impact, Requirement Gap, or Unclear issue that requires upstream requirements or design revision.
When post-API/E2E durable test-code review passes and the complete validated package is ready for delivery, documentation sync, finalization, or release work.
When API/E2E validation passes, the carried classification is task_size=Large or architectural_risk=High, and the cumulative evidence package requires proportional test-code review.
When API/E2E validation fails and the complete failure package requires focused failure-origin review by the code reviewer.

When API/E2E validation passes on the direct route, the carried classification is task_size=Small or Medium and architectural_risk=Low, no durable test-code review is required by policy, and the complete validated package is ready for delivery, documentation sync, finalization, or release work.
When delivery discovers a code or packaging Local Fix that must be corrected by implementation before finalization can continue.
When delivery discovers a Design Impact, Requirement Gap, or Unclear issue, or final handoff is blocked by a non-deployment issue that requires upstream classification.
